jefferson_county.source: 2026 FDT_508.pdf maps pp.6, 7, 17, 25; Wildlife Code 3 CSR 10-7.433 p.57

bear_management_zone.basis: Jefferson County lies east of MO-47 and south of the Missouri River, inside the BMZ 2 boundary (north from the Arkansas border on US-63 to I-44; east on I-44 to MO-47; north on MO-47 to the Missouri River; east along the river to the Illinois border).

seasons.name: Archery Deer
seasons.notes: Statewide. Residents: two antlered deer archery + firearms combined; only one antlered deer during archery before Nov. 14. Nonresident any-deer / archer permits: one antlered deer for both seasons combined (FDT p.5, 20, 72).
seasons.approved: Missouri Conservation Commission; printed in 2026 FDT booklet

seasons.name: Firearms Early Antlerless
seasons.notes: Jefferson County is OPEN (FDT p.25 orange; 3 CSR 10-7.433 lists Jefferson). Antlerless deer only. Four firearms antlerless permits may be filled in Jefferson during all firearms portions combined (FDT p.17). Hunter orange required.
seasons.approved: Missouri Conservation Commission; printed in 2026 FDT booklet

seasons.name: Black Bear (BMZ 2)
seasons.notes: Resident draw-permit holders only, zone-specific. Season closes early in a BMZ if its harvest quota is reached (statewide: 2,000 permits, 60-bear quota). Lone bears only; no sows with cubs; no denned bears; no bait; no dogs; hunter orange required. Bear rules are not in the FDT booklet; source is 3 CSR 10-7.900 / MDC bear pages.

daily_requirement.action: Call 800-668-4045 before hunting each day to check quota/closure status.

post_harvest: Present bear at designated MDC check station
Submit premolar tooth to MDC Furbearer Program within 10 days

removed_in_2026.detail: Zone concept removed for 2026-27 (FDT p.72 What's New). County-specific feed/mineral and sampling rules remain.

removed_in_2026.item: CWD Portion of firearms deer season
removed_in_2026.detail: Eliminated (FDT p.72). Do not render a CWD/antlerless-CWD layer.

advisories.title: CWD sampling — Jefferson County
advisories.detail: Jefferson County is not shaded on the Nov 14–15, 2026 mandatory CWD sampling map (FDT p.7). Free voluntary testing is available all season (mdc.mo.gov/CWD). Mandatory sampling now rotates statewide on a four-year cycle; Jefferson is not in the 2026 cohort. If you hunt a shaded county on Nov 14–15, take the deer or head to a station that day.

advisories.title: Feed and mineral placement prohibited
advisories.detail: Jefferson County is shaded on the FDT p.6 map. Grain, salt products, minerals, and other consumable products used to attract deer are prohibited year-round. Exceptions: feed within 100 feet of a residence or occupied building; feed placed so deer cannot reach it; normal agricultural, forest-management, or wildlife food-plot practices; feed used in an MDC-authorized feral-swine or CWD effort. Statewide, mineral blocks that contain grain or other food additives are illegal bait (FDT p.4).

advisories.title: Deer Telecheck deadline
advisories.detail: Notch the permit immediately after harvest. Telecheck the deer before transporting it out of the county of harvest or by 10 p.m. on the day of harvest, whichever comes first (FDT pp.6, 64–65; 3 CSR 10-7.431). MO Hunting app, mdc.mo.gov, or 1-866-227-2564. Keep the confirmation number on the carcass until processing. The deer must stay intact or field-dressed until Telechecked.

reminders.title: Apply for 2027 black bear permit draw
reminders.detail: Missouri residents apply during May at mdc.mo.gov/buypermits; drawing results ~July 1. Shown to all users regardless of permit status.

rut.method: Regional whitetail rut pattern for east-central Missouri; peak estimated Nov 6–15 ±5 days. Heuristic, not MDC data.

moon.method: Astronomical phase algorithm as in existing app.
